subject: gk
question: Which of the following is an essential feature of the Green Revolution?

options.text: Increase in the role and responsibility of the government.
Good quality labour can increase industrial productivity.
HYV seeds have led to a substantial rise in crop productivity.

solution:
The correct answer is __**HYV seeds have led to a substantial rise in crop productivity.**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• High Yielding Variety (HYV) seeds were one of the most significant components of the Green Revolution, aimed at increasing food grain production, especially in developing countries.
 
• HYV seeds are more responsive to fertilizers, leading to a higher yield per hectare compared to traditional seeds.
 
• The introduction of HYV seeds has significantly increased the productivity of staple crops such as wheat and rice.
 
• HYV seeds have contributed to food security and reduced dependency on food imports in many countries.
